page_title: HAV 0-1 REN | Le Havre v Rennes 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Azor Matusiwa (Rennes) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
90+3' Le Havre hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Steve Mandanda, who pulls off a comfortable save!

88' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
85' Julien Stephan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ludovic Blas (Rennes) replacing Benjamin Bourigeaud.

83' What a save from Steve Mandanda! Andre Ayew (Le Havre) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
82' Great teamplay by Le Havre as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
79' Alidu Seidu (Rennes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Millot had an easy-decision to make.
79' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Le Havre.
76' The game has come to an end for Mohamed Bayo. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Antoine Joujou (Le Havre).
76' Luka Elsner decides to make a substitution. Loic Nego will be replaced by Steve Ngoura (Le Havre).
76' Arnaud Kalimuendo goes off the pitch and Amine Gouiri (Rennes) comes on.

76' Close! Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
75' A player from Le Havre brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
74' Rennes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
72' The game is interrupted now, Adrien Truffert (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Andre Ayew (Le Havre) for his blatant foul.

67' Le Havre keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
65' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Emmanuel Sabbi as he is replaced by Andre Ayew (Le Havre).

61' We are about to witness a substitution. Ibrahim Salah (Rennes) is replacing Desire Doue.
60' 0 - 1 Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to release a low effort which ends up in the middle of the net.

57' Guela Doue (Rennes) gets on the end of a pass and tries a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a wild attempt that goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
54' One of the players from Rennes times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
52' Le Havre keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
49' Benjamin Bourigeaud (Rennes) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.

49' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) swirls around the defenders and shoots from inside the box. His promising effort goes past the goalkeeper, but one of the defenders gets back and knocks the ball onto the post. Corner kick. Rennes will have an opportunity.
47' Steve Mandanda comes off his line to intercept the corner from Christopher Operi (Le Havre).
47' Christopher Operi (Le Havre) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save. Le Havre have been awarded a corner kick.

47' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going in the bottom right corner, but Steve Mandanda has other ideas and makes a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. Le Havre will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Benoit Millot has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Le Havre are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' The current number of shots on goal is 1:0.
43' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Benoit Millot blows his whistle for an infringement.

41' A short pass finds Emmanuel Sabbi (Le Havre). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.
40' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
36' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
35' A long pass finds Guela Doue (Rennes) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.

32' Desire Doue (Rennes) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
31' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

26' Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul after Josue Casimir (Le Havre) hacks down one of his opponents.

23' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
19' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Steve Mandanda is alert and denies him with a nice save.
16' Mohamed Bayo (Le Havre) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Benoit Millot blows his whistle for a foul.
12' A rebound lands at the feet of Josue Casimir (Le Havre), whose promising strike from long range smashes against left post! What an opportunity that was!
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Le Havre comes to nothing.

3' Rennes are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
